# Heath

> Heath is a sleep wearable in development. It follows your sleep through the night and settles the restless moments with warmth, sound or a light touch, so you get the most restorative sleep and recover best. Not yet for sale. Not a medical device.

## Docs

- [Overview for agents (Markdown)](index.md): what Heath is, how it works, the evidence behind the signals, status, principles, how to join the waitlist
- [Structured facts (JSON)](heath.json): the same information as machine-readable data
- [For agents (HTML)](agents.html): human-readable version of the agent docs

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): the site is a single page; the waitlist form is at the end of it
